texts.zh: 24000年之前，星系之中的一颗坍缩恒星发出的伽玛射线暴直接照射到了[From.GetName]星球表面。[From.GetPlanetMoon]被致命辐射覆盖，不仅面向射线的[From.GetName]大多数生命形态都被辐射感染，同时大部分的臭氧层也被破坏。这次大灭绝使星球大概86%的生物消失，包括早期青铜时代的文明，他们的遗迹至今仍然存在于北半球的一些地区。目前当地的生物圈有了一些恢复的迹象。
texts.en:
24,000 years ago [From.GetName] had the misfortune of being directly in the path of a long gamma-ray burst from a collapsing star within our galaxy. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] was washed with lethal radiation, which not only produced acute radiation poisoning in most life forms on the side of [From.GetName] that happened to be facing the burst, but also depleted much of the ozone layer.

This extinction event killed off an estimated 86% of all biota, including an early Bronze Age civilization whose ruins can still be found in some parts of the northern hemisphere. The biosphere is only now showing signs of recovery.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 放射性行星 / Radioactive Planet

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:481-495` · `events/anomaly_events_1.txt:4658-4681 (anomaly.680)`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 2级异常；在墓穴世界（未禁用）上以权重3生成。  
  Level-2 anomaly; spawn weight 3 on tomb worlds (not disabled).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 680“伽马线爆”：2.4万年前一次长伽马射线暴灭绝了86%的生物与一个青铜时代文明（行星设置 nuked_planet_anomalies_disabled，加2个放射性废墟障碍，给予标本）。  
  680 "Gamma-Ray Burst": 24,000 years ago a gamma-ray burst killed 86% of life and a Bronze Age civilization (sets nuked_planet_anomalies_disabled, two radioactive-ruin blockers, a specimen).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单一结果；完成后该行星不再生成其他墓穴世界异常。  
  Single outcome; afterwards the planet can no longer spawn the other tomb-world anomalies.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别与680。  
  Category and 680.
- 覆盖 Coverage：2 个文档全部核对 / all 2 docs checked.
